judge.rationale: The candidate implements the exact same core contract and accumulation semantics as the reference, renaming the `afterModelResponse` parameter to `totalUsage` and summing `inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, and `totalTokens` across reporting rounds while preserving `undefined` when no rounds report usage. Its test coverage actually matches the ticket wording slightly more literally than the reference by driving two tool rounds (three provider calls) rather than one tool round, and explicitly verifying a turn where no rounds report usage. However, the candidate places its tests in a new `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than extending `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, leaves the updated `afterModelResponse` bullets under the `Measured semantics — out of scope` heading in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of promoting them to the main spec section, and omits the secondary doc syncs in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`.
